title: AIOS Status Schema
description: Schema for an AIOS run-state snapshot (schema 'aios-status-v1'). Applies to: (1) the legacy root status.json in single-run mode, and (2) runs/{runId}/status.json in multi-run mode (parallelism Fase A) — the per-run state has the SAME 13-field shape, just namespaced under a run-dir. In multi-run mode the ROOT status.json instead becomes a lightweight index validated by runs-index.schema.json (schema 'aios-runs-index-v1'). Consumed live by /continue (Nivel 2 crash detection) and checkpoint-protocol (project/phase/activeTask/activeAgent + recovery fields: activeStoryFile, modifiedFiles, recoveryHint, lastActivityIds, lastUpdate). The state_graph/handoff-migration fields (graphInstanceId, handoffPhase, handoffFailures) were removed in M3 (motor leve): no live reader after state_graph.json was deprecated in P2.

activeAgent.description: Currently active agent, null when idle

activeTask.description: Description of the currently active task, null when idle

project.description: Name of the current project, null when idle

phase.description: Current phase of the AIOS workflow cycle

sessionStart.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the current session started, null when idle

taskStart.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the current task started, null when idle

lastUpdate.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the last status update

cycleCount.description: Number of AIOS cycles completed in the current session

agentsSpawned.description: List of agents spawned in the current task cycle

activeStoryFile.description: Active story file name (e.g. story-20260218T170000.md), null when no story file exists

lastActivityIds.description: Snapshot of max IDs from activity-log.json at last status update

modifiedFiles.description: List of file paths modified during the current task cycle

recoveryHint.description: Brief description of next action, used for crash recovery context

missionComplexity.description: Complexity classification of the current mission, determined by ULTRON during analysis phase. 'simple' = FORGE+AEGIS only (no VIGIL), 'medium' = full standard cycle, 'complex' = full cycle + Deliberative Group Chat. Null when idle or not yet classified.
